page_title: Octuo — an assistant that works through your other AI tools | macOS & iOS

sources.entry: Octuo - Personal assistant for work across AI, tools and specialist services that coordinates connected, authorized tools and accounts, tracks progress and gathers results around your goal.

summary.name: Octuo
summary.one_liner: Octuo is a paid, credit-based AI personal assistant for Mac, web and iPhone that coordinates your other AI tools, coding agents and MCP tools toward a goal you describe.
use_cases: Delegating code fixes to Claude Code or Codex
Building launch checklists and habit trackers
Running long multi-step jobs that continue across sessions
Scheduling recurring jobs and condition watches
Storing credentials securely for AI tools
Approving agent decisions from an iPhone
summary.what_it_does: Octuo takes a goal from the user and prepares the parts it can, then hands specialist work to tools such as Claude Code, Codex or MCP tools, using the user's own accounts and authorizations. It can install and configure supported coding CLIs, carry context to each run, track runs and bring results back into one conversation. Its Canvas feature lays out checklists, trackers and dashboards as interactive views that the user and assistant can both edit. Long jobs, schedules and condition watches run in the background, with decisions routed to an Attention view. Credentials are kept in an encrypted Secrets Vault that the language model does not see, and memory is browsable and editable.
notable: Coordinates Claude Code, Codex and MCP tools under the user's own accounts
Encrypted Secrets Vault that the language model never sees
Canvas interactive checklists and trackers, plus iPhone companion app
caveats: Paid credit-based product (OC); plans start at $20 USD a month, with a one-time 1,000 OC trial for new accounts
Mac requires macOS 15 or later and at least 8 GB memory (16 GB recommended); iOS requires iOS 18 or later
Claude Code and Codex subscriptions are billed separately by their providers
Most model calls go to cloud-hosted models; Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions are needed on Mac
